Rules.InvariantScript:
Sort(
    Filter(
        Equipment_Bookings As bk,
        IsBlank(varBookingDevice)
            || bk.Title = varBookingDevice,
        IsEmpty(colGroupFilter)
            || LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = bk.Title).OwnerGroup.Value
                in colGroupFilter.Value
            || LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = bk.Title).UserGroup.Value
                in colGroupFilter.Value,
        drpBookingFilter.Selected.Value = "All"
            || (drpBookingFilter.Selected.Value = "Current and upcoming" && bk.EndDate >= Today())
            || (drpBookingFilter.Selected.Value = "My bookings only"
                && bk.ReservedBy.Email = User().Email)
    ),
    StartDate,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

With(
    { a: LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = ThisItem.Title) },
    Coalesce(a.DeviceName, ThisItem.Title, "?")
        & "   (" & Coalesce(ThisItem.Title, "?") & ")"
        & If(IsBlank(ThisItem.LinkedSetupID), "", "   setup " & ThisItem.LinkedSetupID)
)

With(
    { a: LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = ThisItem.Title) },
    Text(ThisItem.StartDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate) & " - " &
    Text(ThisItem.EndDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate) &
    "   |   " & Coalesce(ThisItem.ReservedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
    If(IsBlank(a.OwnerGroup.Value), "", "   |   " & a.OwnerGroup.Value) &
    If(IsBlank(a.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value), "", "   |   " & a.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value) &
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.ProjectCode), "", "   |   " & ThisItem.ProjectCode)
)

With(
    { q: Lower(Trim(txtBkDeviceSearch.Text)) },
    FirstN(
        Sort(
            Filter(
                Equipment_Assets,
                !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Titel, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(DeviceName, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(Manufacturer, ""))))
                    || !IsBlank(Find(q, Lower(Coalesce(SerialNumber, ""))))
            ),
            Titel
        ),
        25
    )
)

If(
    IsBlank(varBookingDevice),
    "Nothing chosen - type below to search",
    With(
        { a: LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = varBookingDevice) },
        varBookingDevice & " - " & Coalesce(a.DeviceName, "?")
            & If(IsBlank(a.Manufacturer), "", "  (" & a.Manufacturer & ")")
    )
)
If(Parent.Width < 600, "Search ID, device, maker", "Type to search by ID, device or manufacturer")

"LAB GROUPS - OWNER OR USER" &
 If(
     IsEmpty(colGroupFilter),
     "   (all)",
     "   (" & CountRows(colGroupFilter) & " selected)"
 )

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colGroupFilter.Value,
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1),
    RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colGroupFilter.Value,
    RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colGroupFilter.Value,
    RGBA(16, 110, 190, 1),
    RGBA(235, 243, 252, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.Value in colGroupFilter.Value,
    Remove(
        colGroupFilter,
        LookUp(colGroupFilter, Value = ThisItem.Value)
    ),
    Collect(colGroupFilter, { Value: ThisItem.Value })
)

If(
    ThisItem.CellDate = varCalDay, RGBA(0, 120, 212, 1),
    ThisItem.Bookings >= 3,        RGBA(247, 193, 122, 1),
    ThisItem.Bookings = 2,         RGBA(252, 221, 181, 1),
    ThisItem.Bookings = 1,         RGBA(254, 240, 217, 1),
    ThisItem.CellDate = Today(),   RGBA(222, 236, 249, 1),
    Not(ThisItem.InMonth),         RGBA(250, 250, 250, 1),
    RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1)
)

If(
    ThisItem.CellDate = varCalDay, RGBA(255, 255, 255, 1),
    Not(ThisItem.InMonth),         RGBA(200, 198, 196, 1),
    RGBA(50, 49, 48, 1)
)

Upper(Text(varCalDay, DateTimeFormat.LongDate)) & "   -   " &
CountRows(galDayBookings.AllItems) & " booking(s)" &
If(
    IsEmpty(colGroupFilter),
    "",
    "   -   " & Concat(colGroupFilter, Value, ", ")
)

Sort(
    Filter(
        Equipment_Bookings As bk,
        bk.StartDate <= varCalDay,
        bk.EndDate >= varCalDay,
        IsBlank(varBookingDevice)
            || bk.Title = varBookingDevice,
        IsEmpty(colGroupFilter)
            || LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = bk.Title).OwnerGroup.Value in colGroupFilter.Value
            || LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = bk.Title).UserGroup.Value in colGroupFilter.Value
    ),
    StartDate,
    SortOrder.Ascending
)

With(
    { a: LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = ThisItem.Title) },
    Coalesce(a.DeviceName, ThisItem.Title, "?")
        & "   (" & Coalesce(ThisItem.Title, "?") & ")"
        & If(IsBlank(ThisItem.LinkedSetupID), "", "   setup " & ThisItem.LinkedSetupID)
)

With(
    { a: LookUp(Equipment_Assets, Titel = ThisItem.Title) },
    Text(ThisItem.StartDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate) & " - " &
    Text(ThisItem.EndDate, DateTimeFormat.ShortDate) &
    "   |   " & Coalesce(ThisItem.ReservedBy.DisplayName, "?") &
    If(IsBlank(a.OwnerGroup.Value), "", "   |   " & a.OwnerGroup.Value) &
    If(IsBlank(a.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value), "", "   |   " & a.'CurrentLocation (CurrentLocation0)'.Value) &
    If(IsBlank(ThisItem.ProjectCode), "", "   |   " & ThisItem.ProjectCode)
)
